items.title: India assumes Chair of Common Criteria Development Board
items.whyInNews: India has assumed the chair of the Common Criteria Development Board (CCDB) as per the news on 15 May 2026. The CCDB is an international organisation that develops and maintains standards for the evaluation of security products.
items.summary: The Common Criteria Development Board (CCDB) is an international organisation that develops and maintains standards for the evaluation of security products. India has assumed the chair of the CCDB, which is a significant development in the field of cybersecurity. The CCDB is responsible for developing and maintaining the Common Criteria for Information Technology Security Evaluation, which is an international standard for evaluating the security of IT products.
